map.支持普通 Base64 与 Base64Url 格式，正确处理 Unicode: Supports standard Base64 and Base64URL, correctly handling Unicode text.
map.Base64 把每 3 字节（24 位）重分为 4 个 6 位组，每组映射到 6: Base64 regroups every 3 bytes (24 bits) into 4 groups of 6 bits, each mapped to a 64-char table (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, plus, slash); short groups are zero-padded and filled with equals (1 missing byte -> 2 equals, 2 missing -> 1 equals); encoded length = ceil(original / 3) * 4; Base64URL uses hyphen for plus, underscore for slash and drops padding; Unicode text must be UTF-8 byte-encoded first.
map.编码：将任意文本转换为 Base64 字符串。: Encoding: convert any text into a Base64 string.
map.解码：将 Base64 字符串还原为原始文本，失败会提示错误。: Decoding: restore a Base64 string to the original text; failure shows an error.
map.Base64Url 将 + 替换为 -，/ 替换为 _，并去除末尾 =。: Base64URL replaces + with -, / with _, and removes the trailing =.
map.令牌/签名传输：JWT、签名等 Base64Url 片段的编解码。: Token/signature transfer: encode/decode Base64URL fragments like JWT and signatures.
map.调试核对：对抓取到的 Base64 串解码查看原文。: Debug check: decode a captured Base64 string to view the original.
map.ToolBox → VG9vbEJveA==；解码回推即得原文本，注意 padd: ToolBox -> VG9vbEJveA==; decode back to the original text, mind the padding =.
map.后者把 +/ 换成 -_ 并去掉填充，适合放在 URL/文件名中不被转义。: The latter replaces +/ with -_ and drops padding, so it sits in URLs/file names without escaping.
map.需先按 UTF-8 编码为字节再 Base64，否则会按平台默认编码出错。: UTF-8 byte-encode first, then Base64; otherwise the platform default encoding causes errors.
map.长度非 4 倍数、填充缺失或混用标准/Url 变体。: Length not a multiple of 4, missing padding, or mixing standard/URL variants.
